source.notes: ICSE Grade VIII school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'ANNUAL EXAMINATION 2018-19', 'GRADE VIII', 'CHEMISTRY', 'MARKS 80'; no duration is printed. examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. 'Section I is compulsory. Attempt any four questions from Section II.' Section I (40 marks) is Question 1 a-i; each of a-g prints marks only for its group of five items, so each is one entry. 1(h) has no stem (the scan prints 'h. question missing') and no marks; 7(b) prints no marks; both are stored as 0 and flagged. Section II has six questions (2-7) of which any four are to be attempted, so the listed marks add up to more than 80. Marks in Section II are often printed between two parts; they were assigned by position (each mark sits just above or beside its part). Item 1(b)(ii) is overwritten on the scan and partly illegible. Subscripts, charges and arrows were rebuilt from the page images as Unicode. A promotional footer (WhatsApp number, partly in Hindi) on page 4 is not part of the paper and is ignored. Chapter null: 1(g) (differences across several unrelated topics) and 7(c) (indicators; no acids/bases chapter in the list). No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
